description: Kotlin Multiplatform + Compose media toolkit for Android and iOS: play video and audio (including audio sprites â trigger clips of one sound file for events), render images, animated GIFs, and animated, interactive, runtime-editable SVG, clip any media to built-in or free-form polygon (lasso) shapes â including feathered/gradient soft masks and multi-region clips â drive playback with live position/duration and seek, compose depth-layered scenes with z-order and depth-of-field, generate or patch vector shapes and SVGs from a language model via a provider-agnostic JSON interop layer (describe to shape / patch, or turn an image into editable vector shapes with a vision model), and compose layered, keyframe-animated scenes on one timeline (OGComposition), preview them live at 60fps and export them to a shareable animated GIF with a pure-Kotlin on-device encoder or to an H.264 MP4 with the OS video encoder, and apply shareable, data-defined drawing styles as a JSON pipeline of procedural ops (boiling/wiggly lines, quantize, pixelate), and turn any graphic (photo, SVG, or lasso-cut cut-out) into a shape-aware tappable button with built-in press effects (Modifier.ogButton) â all with no third-party dependencies, identical on both platforms.
